lines.trans: Nina is standing by the window.
Wave her off with your hand.
Wave her off, I tell you.
Come on, it feels awkward somehow.

meanings.note: иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind

examples.text: Из окна красивый вид на парк.
examples.trans: There is a nice view of the park from the window.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.
Even I feel a bit ashamed right now.
It became somehow quiet in the room.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
when the exact choice doesn't matter; first part declines like какой
в любой момент = at any moment

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Мне неудобно = I feel awkward / bad about it

examples.trans: It is very uncomfortable to sit here.
He is looking out the window.

отмахнуться.gloss: to wave off, to brush aside

meanings.note: make a brushing-off gesture with a hand

examples.trans: Wave her off with your hand.

meanings.note: used on its own: он пьёт = he drinks

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.en: to try, to attempt, to make an effort

examples.trans: He tried to explain the situation.

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.trans: They put bad meat in there for you.
